summary: The change makes tax_for return None for unknown regions, where it used to return zero tax.

findings.title: None return breaks both tax_for callers
findings.problem: tax_for now returns None for an unknown region. order_total adds the result to an int, and tax_line divides it by 100.
findings.consequence: Checkout and receipt printing raise TypeError for every order from a region missing in RATES. Customers in those regions cannot complete an order.
findings.fix: Keep returning 0 for unknown regions. Otherwise, update order_total and tax_line in the same change to handle None.

findings.title: Unknown-region branch has no covering test
findings.problem: The change adds a new branch for unknown regions. No test in the repository exercises tax_for or its callers.
findings.consequence: A test would have caught the TypeError in order_total and tax_line. Future regressions on this path will also go unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add tests for tax_for, order_total and tax_line with both a known and an unknown region.
